නමෝ තස්ස භගවතෝ අරහතෝ සම්මා සම්බුද්ධස්ස !

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”||||||||” text_font_size=”16px” global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”]

ඒ භාග්‍යවත් අරහත් සම්මා සම්බුදු රජාණන් වහන්සේට මාගේ නමස්කාරය වේවා!

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”|600|||||||” text_font_size=”20px” global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”]

බුද්ධං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි
ධම්මං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි
සංඝං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”||||||||” text_font_size=”16px” global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”]

මම බුදුරජාණන් වහන්සේ සරණ යමි.
මම ශ්‍රී සද්ධර්මය සරණ යමි.
මම ආර්ය මහා සංඝරත්නය සරණ යමි.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”|600|||||||” text_font_size=”20px” global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”]

දුතියම්පි ධම්මං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි
දුතියම්පි සංඝං සරණං ගච්ඡාමි

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||” theme_builder_area=”post_content”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”||||||||” text_font_size=”16px” global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content”]
